estimator_stack.chi_H: conflict chromatic; counts distinguishable copies; misses Tier-3 collapsed_excess
estimator_stack.depth_cn: expressed-copy count incl identical; confounded by expression; blind to silent

collapsed_families_need_depth.note: families with collapsed_excess>0 -- chi(H) undercounts; depth is the only RNA signal

validation_vs_DNA.note: asm_hapCN = DNA per-haplotype genomic CN (max(mat,pat)); VALIDATION ONLY, never gates. RNA depth is a LOWER bound (silent copies invisible).

silent_copy_undercount.interpretation: median depth-CN is this fraction of the DNA copy number; <1 => systematic under-count = confound C2 (silent copies)

confounds.C3_conclusion: depth-CN is a NOISY LOWER BOUND on genomic CN, not an unbiased estimate
